statement: Computed estimate from CHGNet v0.3.0 relaxations. Not an experimental measurement; no synthesis, validation, or discovery claim is made.

d004_comparison.decision: D-004 option A (DECIDED 2026-10-21): beat a named baseline on a single metric

stability.caveat: Zero-kelvin computed value (DFT, Materials Project); ignores kinetics and entropy. Says nothing about whether the phase actually forms under real synthesis conditions.

literature_crosscheck.capacity_citation: yamada-2001-lmp (one-electron M3+/M2+ redox, host-formula basis per D-005)
literature_crosscheck.offset_note: offset field = predicted minus literature (3.6865 - 4.1 = -0.4135 V). Predicted voltage sits 0.41 V below the literature Mn3+/Mn2+ plateau (D-008 DECIDED 2026-10-22, option A: chemistry-correlated offset up to ~0.4-0.5 V on layered Co oxides AND Mn olivine; Fe olivine and Mn spinel verified within ~0.03 V). Relative rankings within one chemistry are usable; absolute cross-chemistry comparisons are not.
literature_crosscheck.practicality_note: The literature also reports kinetic and electrode-engineering obstacles for pure LiMnPO4 (capacity far below theoretical, large polarization, Fe coexistence needed at the 4c site, Jahn-Teller instability of Mn-rich compositions). These are distinct from this zero-kelvin thermodynamic estimate and are not contradicted by it.
